<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*Assailants raid a village in [[Papua New Guinea]]'s [[Hela Province|Hela]] province, killing and dismembering 16 women and children, and burning buildings. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/jul/10/at-least-15-women-and-children-killed-in-tribal-massacre-in-papua-new-guinea (''The Guardian'')]
*Three or five of [[Iran]]'s [[Navy of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps|IRGC Navy]] gunboats unsuccessfully attempt to seize control of [[United Kingdom|British]] oil tanker ''British Heritage'' in the [[Persian Gulf]], according to UK's Ministry of Defense as well as two anonymous U.S. officials. The [[Royal Navy]]'s [[HMS Montrose (F236)|HMS ''Montrose'']] reportedly warns the boats to back away from the [[BP Shipping]]-owned tanker, which they do. The incident is allegedly captured on a U.S. aircraft's camera. [https://edition.cnn.com/2019/07/10/politics/iran-attempted-seize-british-tanker/ (CNN)]

;Business and economy
*Three large [[shipbuilding|shipbuilders]] in the [[China|People's Republic of China]] announce that they are in talks to merge. This is part of an ongoing shake-up and consolidation of that industry in the face of high operational costs and sluggish new orders. [https://www.caixinglobal.com/2019-07-10/exclusive-three-more-chinese-shipbuilders-in-merger-talks-101437571.html (Caixin Eng.)]

;Disasters and accidents
*An unexpected violent storm hits the Greek region of [[Halkidiki]] with heavy rain, hail, and strong winds, killing six foreign tourists. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-48945821 (BBC News)]

;International relations
*[[United Kingdom–United States relations]]
**Sir [[Kim Darroch]], the United Kingdom's [[List of ambassadors of the United Kingdom to the United States|ambassador]] to the United States, resigns his appointment amid public disagreements with [[U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] initiated by a series of leaked [[diplomatic cable]]s in which the ambassador criticized the president, and will leave the post upon the appointment of his successor. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-48937120 (BBC News)]
*[[Kosovo–Serbia relations]]
**[[Ministry of Defence (Serbia)|Serbian Defense Minister]] [[Aleksandar Vulin]] is banned from entering [[Kosovo]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/amp/International/wireStory/serbian-defense-minister-banned-kosovo-64242031 (ABC News)]

;Law and crime
*[[List of lawsuits involving Donald Trump]]
**The [[United States Court of Appeals for the Fourth Circuit|U.S. Court of Appeals for the Fourth Circuit]] dismisses [[D.C. and Maryland v. Trump|a lawsuit]] by the state of [[Maryland]] and the [[Washington, D.C.|District of Columbia]] against [[President of the United States|President]] [[Donald Trump]], citing lack of [[Standing (law)|legal standing]] in challenging payments to President Trump's private properties by foreign customers. [https://www.cnbc.com/2019/07/10/trump-wins-dismissal-of-emoluments-suit.html (CNBC)] [https://www.politico.com/story/2019/07/10/donald-trump-emoluments-lawsuit-1405767 (Politico)]

;Science and technology
*[[2019 in archaeology]]
**[[Paleoanthropologists]] announce, through the [[Nature (journal)|''Nature'']] journal, that a [[human]] [[skull]] ([[Apidima 1]]) discovered inside a cave in [[Greece]], is dated to 210,000 years ago, making it the oldest known ''[[Homo sapiens]]'' individual found outside of [[Africa]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/science-environment-48913307 (BBC News)] [https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-019-1376-z (''Nature'')]

;Sports
*[[2019 Cricket World Cup]]
**[[New Zealand national cricket team|New Zealand]] defeats [[India national cricket team|India]] in the first semi-final of the [[2019 Cricket World Cup|Cricket World Cup]]. [https://www.independent.co.uk/sport/cricket/india-vs-new-zealand-world-cup-result-final-score-latest-news-update-a8998956.html (''The Independent'')]
*[[2019 ESPY Awards]]
**The 27th annual [[ESPY Awards]] are held in the [[Microsoft Theater]] in [[Los Angeles]], [[California]]. The [[United States women's national soccer team]] wins the [[Outstanding Team ESPY Award|Outstanding Team Award]] for their [[2019 FIFA Women's World Cup]] victory, [[Giannis Antetokounmpo]] wins the [[Best Male Athlete ESPY Award|Best Male Athlete Award]], [[Alex Morgan]] wins the [[Best Female Athlete ESPY Award|Best Female Athlete Award]], and [[Saquon Barkley]] wins the [[Best Breakthrough Athlete ESPY Award|Breakthrough Athlete of the Year Award]]. [https://www.espn.com/espn/story/_/id/27164007/uswnt-morgan-take-home-top-honors-espys (ESPN)]
